justification: Minimal repair replaces the bare EL verb with its morphologically integrated infinitive form. The 'tiene que + infinitive' frame forces the infinitive shape uniquely; no tense ambiguity.

provenance.review_disagreement: Independent blind reviewer repaired to 'Tiene que typear el reporte.' -- an attested alternate integration spelling alongside the phonetic-respelled 'taipear', not a different construction. Added as alternate_repairs.
